verdict.rationale: The Texas SOS's own pages say founders can file the LLC Certificate of Formation (Form 205) online through SOSPortal. They also say all documents can be filed there, with payment by ACH or credit card and status tracking under My Submissions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end online filing and payment, since the filing host itself was not examined.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Ability to file all documents through SOSPortal, including mergers and conversions
Accepted payment methods in SOSPortal will be ACH and credit card.
Start a business, perform name searches and do much more.
